sample.Description: Sample represents the volume of the fMRI run. So sample 1 means the first volume is currently being imaged.

trial_type.Description: Indicator of type of action that happened

Levels.TRIGGER: A trigger was received from the scanner. Value represents which trial the task is currently on
Levels.DOT_FLIP: The attention dot at the center of the screen changed color. Values 0 and 1 represent color change to darker or lighter
Levels.KEYPRESS: The participant pressed a button. Value represents the key which was pressed in the button box

response_time.Description: For KEYPRESS, this corresponds to the participant's Reaction Time with respect to the preceding DOT_FLIP. For TRIGGER it represents the instantaneous phase from 0 to 2*pi of the active task trial

value.Description: Value codes for information that takes different meanings according to trial_type. See description above
